basis: Dentin, enamel, tooth size and root abnormalities define this dental disorder; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Isolated progressive sensorineural hearing loss.
Developmental delay, intellectual disability and movement abnormalities define the disorder; isolated ocular findings do not establish common eye damage.
Rickettsia typhi infection; rash is transient, and substantial damage to additional organs is not common enough to include.
Neoplasm arising in the ileal wall; lymphoma is only one possible subtype.
Disease of the anterior pituitary, an endocrine gland; its intracranial location alone does not establish neurologic involvement.
Intestinal smooth-muscle dysfunction causes chronic pseudo-obstruction; visceral smooth muscle does not imply skeletal-muscle disease.
Inherited platelet production and survival disorder; myopathy is optional without evidence of frequency >=30%; bleeding manifestations do not establish other organ damage.
Lymphopenia, antibody deficiency, autoimmune hemolytic anemia and glomerulonephritis are defining components; pneumonia frequency is unspecified.
Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy; hypotonia is neurologic, and sleep apnea occurs in only 1/6.
Benign tumour of the frontal sinus, part of the upper respiratory tract; broad bone ancestry does not establish bone involvement.
Hepatic bilirubin conjugation deficiency defines this metabolic disease; kernicterus and lasting neurologic manifestations are occasional (5-29%).
Episodic intrahepatic cholestasis defines the disease; pruritus and jaundice do not establish skin or eye damage; hearing loss and pancreatitis lack frequency support.
Midline dental and nasal malformations define microform disease; intellectual disability occurs in 30-79%; typical forebrain cleavage defects are absent.
Chronic fungal infection directly affects skin and subcutis; ocular, pulmonary and bone damage are very rare (1-4%).
Intellectual disability defines the syndrome; ocular dysfunction, hearing impairment and dental abnormalities each occur in 30-79%; feeding difficulty alone adds no organ.
Inherited cardiac conduction disease with arrhythmias and myocardial abnormalities; genetic myocardial disease does not itself establish an immune mechanism.
Dermatosis directly affects eyelid skin; eyelids are explicitly included in the ocular axis.
Nonsyndromic congenital sideroblastic anemia; elevated ferritin alone does not establish hepatic, cardiac or endocrine damage.
Cerebellar damage defines this form of cerebral palsy; motor dysfunction does not itself establish primary muscle or joint disease.
Ovarian failure and skeletal dysplasia define it; hearing impairment and learning disability each occur in 30-79%; hypertension, thyroiditis and steatosis are separate diseases.
Benign neoplasm arising in the stomach.
Carcinoma arising from cutaneous eccrine sweat glands; these are exocrine glands, and distant metastases are uncommon.
Endometrial lesions affect a reproductive organ outside the 13 axes; tamoxifen exposure does not make this an endocrine-gland disease.
Nonsyndromic uterine malformation lies outside the axes; associated urinary anomalies are separate congenital malformations rather than damage caused by the uterine lesion.
